scope: FEAT-008 required qualification; 158 required cases: original132, 13 field-protection native P-cases and 13 semantic S13-S25. Allocation is not execution; no case retired or promoted.

cases.name: qualified-ontology-path
cases.assertion: Resolve Staff/Project/Ownership/Assignment and require active Assignment to same owning Project.

cases.name: qualified-identity-collision
cases.assertion: Same labels in different documents never join; exact typed keys and Unicode remain distinct.

cases.name: invalid-typed-expression
cases.assertion: Reject wrong endpoint role, undeclared action, boolean/string comparison, unknown operator and depth/node excess.

cases.name: mandatory-overrides-broad-grant
cases.assertion: Broad read permit plus false mandatory membership denies; forbid dominates all permits; rule permutation agrees.

cases.name: active-membership-and-owner-quantifier
cases.assertion: Active same-Project allows; inactive, missing, sibling Client/Project denies; any/all and ownerless behavior explicit.

cases.name: incomplete-trust-refusal
cases.assertion: Missing/ambiguous subject, incomplete assignment inventory, stale cut or untrusted attribute refuses entire collection.

cases.name: disclosure-dispositions
cases.assertion: Null, absence, withheld, constant transform and output type survive encoding; false permits add no obligations; absent protected disposition refuses.

cases.name: protected-query-use
cases.assertion: Predicate/order/group/join/aggregate uses disclosed representation or explicit original-use action; withheld use refuses.

cases.name: native-unknown-roundtrip
cases.assertion: Preserve unknown rules and native source byte content where promised; unknown security meaning blocks interpretation.

cases.name: bun-browser-parity
cases.assertion: Same policy/facts/diagnostics and refusal outcomes in Bun and Chromium, no host globals or external requests.

cases.name: generated-invalid-policy
cases.assertion: Generate corrupted references/types/unknown members; no fabricated trusted issuer or stale classification admits.

cases.name: formal-counterexample-controls
cases.assertion: Retain SAT weakened controls and UNSAT scoped safety checks; assumptions have positive witnesses.

cases.name: protection-reference-resolution
cases.assertion: Resolve exact pinned catalog/transform/version and qualified input/output Field domains; foreign or missing references refuse. Replay the same independent expectations in Bun and real Chromium.

cases.name: unknown-protection-preservation
cases.assertion: Preserve unknown catalog/version/kind/member and native source content through JSON/YAML; unknown meaning blocks interpretation. Replay the same independent expectations in Bun and real Chromium.

cases.name: protection-migration-rollback
cases.assertion: Additive security0.1-to0.2 migration preserves legacy constant meaning; rollback refuses any non-constant reference without changing the source. Replay the same independent expectations in Bun and real Chromium.

cases.name: effective-query-disclosure
cases.assertion: Positive and missing-property refusal controls cover predicate, join, group, order and aggregate dependencies: equality predicates/join/group require retained equality, order requires retained order, and each selected aggregate requires its declared input properties. Omitted queryUse defaults to prohibited. Deterministic transforms report implied equality even if omitted from authored properties. Replay the same independent expectations in Bun and real Chromium.

cases.name: random-token-query-refusal
cases.assertion: Random tokenization cannot admit disclosed equality join/group; a weakened validator ignoring that dependency must be distinguished. Replay the same independent expectations in Bun and real Chromium.

cases.name: protection-bounds
cases.assertion: Catalogs over256 transforms, more than32 typed parameters or canonical JSON literal encodings exceeding4096 UTF-16 units refuse bounded interpretation rather than trimming. Replay the same independent expectations in Bun and real Chromium.

cases.name: pure-protection-independent-oracle
cases.assertion: Constant, partial, fixed-length-redact, range-bucket, truncate-date and prefix-only exact outputs match independently authored Python expectations; keyed/vault operations are not executed by UMF. Replay the same independent expectations in Bun and real Chromium.

cases.name: protection-disposition-transport
cases.assertion: Canonical null, absence, withheld, transformed null, changed output domain and stored token survive disposition transport distinctly. Replay the same independent expectations in Bun and real Chromium.

cases.name: protection-custody-declarations
cases.assertion: Hash declarations require an algorithm and declared salt custody (none or keyed); unsalted hash requires retained equality and a mandatory dictionary-attack warning obligation. Tokenize/encrypt declarations require complete stored custody and propagation metadata; keyed/vault reversibility requires a distinct reverse action. Declarations remain unverified native obligations. Replay the same independent expectations in Bun and real Chromium.

cases.name: independent-reverse-action
cases.assertion: Reverse action is distinct from read/field/original-authorized actions; ordinary/original disposition exposes stored token and never implies plaintext recovery. Replay the same independent expectations in Bun and real Chromium.

cases.name: protection-propagation-declarations
cases.assertion: History, snapshots, exports, feeds and caches each have explicit propagation declarations; missing or unknown required meaning refuses and source is preserved. Replay the same independent expectations in Bun and real Chromium.

cases.name: mask-write-back-admission
cases.assertion: Field mutation without original disposition or explicit field-bound blind-write permission refuses, including a proposed value equal to the mask output. Replay the same independent expectations in Bun and real Chromium.

cases.name: stored-transform-vault-write
cases.assertion: Stored-transformed field mutation additionally requires the exact declared vault-write action; unrelated read/original/reverse permissions cannot substitute. Replay the same independent expectations in Bun and real Chromium.

cases.name: read-membership
cases.assertion: Selected native ordinary identity sees exact oracle resource IDs; active/inactive/sibling/no-owner cases.

cases.name: association-endpoints
cases.assertion: Junction row/typed edge identity and endpoint direction bind faithfully; reversed/wrong-type endpoints refuse.

cases.name: collection-operators
cases.assertion: Lookup/list/count/aggregate/traversal/page all follow eligibility, including all-hidden and empty authorized sets.

cases.name: direct-storage-bypass
cases.assertion: Direct tables, child homes, property bags, raw retained bytes, files and alternate query endpoints cannot bypass admitted policy.

cases.name: native-role-escalation
cases.assertion: Ordinary identity cannot inherit/SET/adopt owner, bypass or internal roles; pool role resets between transactions.

cases.name: definer-resolution
cases.assertion: Overloads, search path, temporary objects, wrapper calls and routine PUBLIC grants cannot enlarge ordinary authority.

cases.name: logical-property-masking
cases.assertion: Original null, absence, redaction and transform differ; forbidden property never escapes bag/retained carrier.

cases.name: mask-query-semantics
cases.assertion: Filter/sort/group/join/aggregate on protected properties follow disclosed/original-authorized/prohibited modes. Raw access requires the profile-bound exact separate action; caller-selected unrelated actions, changed bindings, empty prohibited selections and incomplete original-action dependencies refuse before execution.

cases.name: unsupported-activation
cases.assertion: Unsupported path/mask/history/composition cannot install report-mode weakening; prior protected profile remains.

cases.name: private-fact-observation
cases.assertion: Authorization can consult hidden Assignment facts; ordinary direct/list/count/diagnostic paths disclose none.

cases.name: inventory-drift
cases.assertion: Change owner/grant/membership/routine/policy/column mapping after qualification; admission detects and refuses.

cases.name: receipt-source-custody
cases.assertion: Pin exact engine/build/model/policy/mapping/source/actual-role and per-case outcomes; missing or fabricated receipt refuses.

cases.name: identity-carrier-collision
cases.assertion: Same labels, hash collisions, quoted case, Unicode and composite keys cannot mix ownership or subjects.

cases.name: privileged-negative-control
cases.assertion: Excluded admin actually bypasses ordinary protection; ordinary identities cannot reach that authority.

cases.name: incomplete-collection
cases.assertion: Corrupt one required authority dependency; no silent partial rows/counts/page or success receipt.

cases.name: performance-resource-budget
cases.assertion: At 1k/100k/1M records retain plans/overhead and finite timeout refusal, with no unauthorized partial output.

cases.name: write-old-new-state
cases.assertion: Create/delete/update and ownership-change action compare original/proposed state; failed checks leave no effects.

cases.name: field-write-authority
cases.assertion: Updating forbidden field or policy attribute fails even where object write is permitted; plain SQL path cannot bypass.

cases.name: revocation-drain-barrier
cases.assertion: Hold admitted operation at final release; revoker blocks until drain and acknowledges only after release.

cases.name: streaming-revocation
cases.assertion: Revoke after first streamed page/row; profile either holds admitted guard through last release or refuses streaming before output.

cases.name: read-after-acknowledgment
cases.assertion: After assignment/grant removal acknowledges, a newly admitted read returns no revoked resources.

cases.name: old-snapshot-new-generation
cases.assertion: Begin repeatable-read before revoke, attempt first protected read after acknowledgment; restart/refuse old authority facts.

cases.name: historical-owner-current-authority
cases.assertion: Historical owner differs from current owner or key reused; current assignment with retained original owner alone governs.

cases.name: native-history-policy-eligibility
cases.assertion: Admit actual historical read only under proved native policy/compute/table profile; incompatible historical column fails closed.

cases.name: cursor-cache-rebinding
cases.assertion: Change caller/query/policy/assignment/mapping/data cut; old cursor or cache token cannot bypass fresh admission.

cases.name: derived-copy-feed-propagation
cases.assertion: Serving copies, journals, tombstones, provenance, exports and feed checkpoints preserve declared policy and completeness.

cases.name: missing-custody-or-guard
cases.assertion: Delete retained owner or make guard/fact provider unavailable; refuse without hidden counts or effects.

cases.name: activation-rollback
cases.assertion: Fail policy/mapping migration midway; prior protection survives, and downgrade never broadens ordinary access.

cases.name: authority-change-exhaustiveness
cases.assertion: Assignment activation, role changes, subject remap and relevant attributes advance authority and invalidate stale decisions.

cases.name: effective-date-boundary
cases.assertion: Trusted clock crosses assignment expiry during operation; lease/coordination profile preserves declared cut or refuses.

cases.name: column-privilege-withhold
cases.assertion: Withheld fields are never granted at column level and no ordinary role holds table-level SELECT on a table with withheld columns; selecting a withheld column refuses the whole statement with SQLSTATE 42501, reported as a statement-level refusal and never as a per-cell withheld disposition; permitted columns still match the oracle.

cases.name: protection-transform-correspondence
cases.assertion: Owner-held security_barrier views project each catalog transform (mask function classes, generalize buckets/date truncation, hash) for the authored Resource fields; per-actor disclosed values match the independent Python oracle byte-exact, with storageEffect and output-domain metadata on the disclosure transport; the base table grants no ordinary SELECT.

cases.name: disclosure-profile-query-use
cases.assertion: Native predicate/order/group/join/aggregate behavior over generalize/hash/token carriers is observed per actor and compared to the catalog's effective retained properties: deterministic hash/token joins leak equality classes and are admitted only where the catalog declares equality retained; prohibited operators refuse before rows; the independent weakened-barrier counterexample remains a negative control.

cases.name: mask-write-back-refusal
cases.assertion: A subject whose read disposition on a field is transformed or withheld cannot mutate that field: evaluateSecurityWrite and the write routine refuse without an original read disposition or declared blind-write permission, including a proposed value equal to the mask output; absent column UPDATE privilege is a direct-SQL negative control; RETURNING old/new never discloses the pre-image of a masked or withheld column; failed checks leave no effects.

cases.name: virtual-generated-mask-carrier
cases.assertion: A PostgreSQL 18 virtual generated column over a masked or withheld base column is either qualified by observed privilege/planner behavior at an ordinary role or refused as a mask carrier; refusal installs no weaker profile and the barrier-view carrier remains the admitted one.

cases.name: native-mask-rule-archive
cases.assertion: PostgreSQL Anonymizer SECURITY LABEL masking rules present in the fixture are preserved as native archive, never interpreted as protection or permission; interpretation refuses; the receipt lists the obligation as unverified and the admitted profile is unchanged.

cases.name: tokenization-stand-in
cases.assertion: A stored-transformed Resource field holds deterministic tokens with the plaintext in a vault table owned by an excluded role; the detokenize routine is unreachable by ordinary roles (42501); token equality joins match the oracle; disclosure transport reports storageEffect; dump/replica propagation is declared; all tokenize obligations render unverified and no enforcement is claimed.

cases.assertion: Selected native ordinary identity sees exact oracle resource IDs; active/inactive/sibling/no-owner cases.

cases.assertion: Junction row/typed edge identity and endpoint direction bind faithfully; reversed/wrong-type endpoints refuse.

cases.name: withhold-view-carrier
cases.assertion: withheld maps only to a protected view omitting the column with no base-table SELECT; a NULL-returning column mask is observed at an ordinary identity to be indistinguishable from canonical NULL and the profile mapping withheld to it is refused without weakening the admitted profile.

cases.name: protection-transform-correspondence
cases.assertion: Generated column-mask UDFs for catalog transforms whose output domain is castable to the column type disclose per-actor values matching the independent oracle byte-exact at an ordinary identity; non-castable output domains refuse generation; the receipt pins UDF text, owner and USING COLUMNS inputs.

cases.name: disclosure-profile-query-use
cases.assertion: User predicates/joins/aggregates over masked columns are observed at an ordinary identity (masked versus original evaluation, EXPLAIN and error paths) and compared to the catalog's effective retained properties; prohibited operators on a selectable masked column cannot be natively expressed, so the profile refuses or withholds the column; no claim that Unity Catalog enforces prohibited.

cases.name: native-write-surface-unsupported
cases.assertion: At the native SQL surface an INSERT of a row invisible to the writer's row filter succeeds, so the profile reports write obligations unsupported rather than enforced; ordinary identities hold no direct write grant; any positive write admission flows only through the separately receipted consumer-owned protected write path.

cases.name: native-policy-archive
cases.assertion: ABAC row-filter/column-mask policy DDL present on the fixture is preserved as native archive, never interpreted as protection or permission in this profile; its EXCEPT principals, owners/MANAGE holders and metastore admins are inventoried as privileged exclusions; interpretation refuses and the admitted profile is unchanged.
